hypothesis: Regional native-copper assessment can select generated tracks, arcs and vias in exact dynamic DRC because the caller already discards immutable source-only violations.

detailed.diagnostic: materialized curved route retains 79 non-junction direction changes without quintic PH curve realization

differential_diagnosis.root_cause: Dynamic DRC checked selected tracks/arcs against static vias but omitted the symmetric selected-via versus static-track/static-arc relationships. The net-4 route owned endpoint vias, so its false legality changed regional selection.

interpretation.safety: No board was promoted. The malformed result was rejected before output and never reached KiCad DRC.
interpretation.next_experiment: Add selected-via versus static track/arc checks to the bounded DRC API, prove selected-subset equivalence in a micro-test, and rerun Tier 0 before Tier 1.
